draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane).

coaching.headline: Four favored lane reads and still seven lost fights — three of our four won brawls (7.7, 13.9, 16.2) were traded away for a Fangtooth or Mini Prime across the map, and Sparrow walked out 13/3.
coaching.team: The pattern repeats three times: at 7.7, 13.9 and 16.2 we won the fight while they took Fangtooth or Mini Prime cross-map — four fight wins, only one cashed. The lost fights were the mirror image: the 0-4 at 10.3 to just Terra and Sparrow with the winning mid still in lane, 12.1 and 17.2 with the winning carry absent, and the closing 0-5 in our own jungle at 28.5. The film flags two of us with no armor into a four-fifths-physical comp. Winning lanes while losing the map is a scheduling problem, not a skill problem.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 17.2 loss at their Mini Prime — taken while the winning carry stayed in lane — gave up the 18-minute Mini Prime, and the 26.7 catch on Khaimera priced out Primal Fangtooth and Orb Prime in the same minute.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 healed 16,211 and went 1/4/11 in a support matchup won wire to wire — and the macro flags him three times, at 4.4, 12.1 and 22.7, ahead and absent from fights lost 0-2 and 1-2. Phase's entire kit is a link to a teammate; the winning support's job in this film was to be attached to the jungler who died ten times.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 beat Sparrow in lane — 8/6 with kills on her at 7.7 and 20.5 — but the file flags him at 12.1 and 17.2, ahead in lane while Mini Prime fights were lost short-handed, and the build never reached Imperator, the missing meta core. Murdock's global ult exists precisely to make 'in lane' and 'in the fight' the same thing.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Khaimera put 23088 into objectives but died ten times, and the file prices those falls at three Fangtooths, Mini Prime, and — at 26.7 — Primal Fangtooth plus Orb Prime together. Khaimera out-sustains one enemy at a time; the solo catches at 19.1 and 26.7 and the repeated 2v2s into Terra and Sparrow were fights his kit never wins.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Anima Burst / Whispering Echoes apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets → Soulstorm pulls them in
ourKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets to stick to a target and burst in melee
ourKits.passive: casting grants ranged empowered basics + attack speed
ourKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
ourKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip resets — peel/disengage breaks it; punish when Severance is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
enemyKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
enemyKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 142 healing a minute, more than 92% of Sparrow carry players this patch.
Sparrow dealt 26,698 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +202 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Murdock (level 14: about 90 physical armor, 55 after penetration; took 13,844 physical damage from heroes, 68% of all hero damage they took) and Khaimera (level 15: about 83 physical armor, 50 after penetration; took 16,964 physical damage from heroes, 72% of all hero damage they took) that is about 22% and 22% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.

loadout.plain: Grow bigger and tankier while damaging nearby heroes, then keep some max health permanently. Pop it in the middle of a brawl.

amps.name: Tainted Guard
amps.how: On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.

amps.name: Elafrost
amps.how: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 70 (+2%) Damage On-Hit around the Target. Slows by 35% for 1.5s. Damage is increased by 60% against Monsters.

lead.title: Hard to kill
lead.text: Died 1 time in 29 minutes, fewer deaths than about 85% of Terra offlane players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage. It came from Iron Resolve, Saphir's Mantle, Transference.
